strings.join.title: Enter your invite code
strings.join.body: Enter the 8-character code your partner sent you.
strings.join.found.heading: Join this space?
strings.join.found.title: {name}'s space
strings.join.found.body: You got together on {date}. Joining makes it your space for two.
strings.join.expired.title: This code has expired
strings.join.expired.body: Ask your partner to send a new code.
strings.join.used.title: This code was already used
strings.join.used.body: A code can only be used once. Ask your partner for a new one.
strings.join.invalid.title: That code isn't valid
strings.join.invalid.body: Check the characters. Codes never use 0/O or 1/I.
strings.join.full.title: This space already has two people
strings.join.full.body: You can't join this space. Check with your partner.
strings.join.hasSpace.title: You're already in another space
strings.join.hasSpace.body: You can only be in one space at a time. Leave your current space first (Settings › End space), then enter the code again.
strings.join.ok.title: You're in
strings.join.err: Couldn't check the code. Check your internet connection.
